note: RouteKnower E32: real transition episodes (archived raw polls, prediction updates and alerts rebuilt on the app's 10 s poll grid by experiments/routeknower/E32-scripts/inputs.py, every 3rd poll kept) run through web/js/data/live.js startLive by web/tests/display-run.js. expect / story = the shipped code's answers (make_fixtures.py --expect). kind gap = the current behavior is wrong for riders (RouteKnower E32 has the fix it recommends; the owner decides).
format: static = the slices the app had (shared by the cases); cases[i].polls[j] = {h, v: [[vehicle, trip, route, lat, lon, report time]], u: [snap index], a: [alert index]}; snaps[k] = [vehicle, trip, route, [[stop, time]]]; every time is seconds after the case's t0 (unix); expect[j] = [shown on the case's routes, vehicles whose times are kept, away, {vehicle: number}, vehicle of the next time at the case's stop]

idle.note: Where and from what time buses of a route linger at the end of their shift (RouteKnower E28, experiments/routeknower/E28-scripts/idle_rules.py --write-idle). A bus still for 3 min at a spot of its route after `after` (service-day clock, may pass 24:00) never served riders again in the data; used only while today's listed hours of the route are one of `hours` and before valid_until.

cases.name: offroute_then_silent
cases.says: AP/DX 4317 ends its shift (last arrival 18:13), drives off the line and is hidden with its times at 18:21 (core/offroute.js); its last report is at 18:43, at 18:48 it leaves the operating list (5 min) and its Passio times come back on screen until GONE drops them at 18:58 (15 min).
cases.gap: Rider: times from a bus already at the garage return for up to 10 min (5 to 15 min after its last report). 1,555 bus-minutes Oct 10 to Nov 5 replayed, 153 Nov 6 to 9 (DCC most). corridors.note: The streets each route's buses really drive where its drawn line (shapes.json) is off (RouteKnower E27c, experiments/routeknower/E27-scripts/corridor.py --write): centers of 25 m cells driven in service on at least two thirds of the route's days by at least 5% of its laps, 80 to 400 m from the drawn line. core/offroute.js measures a bus's distance to the line or these points; a route is used only while its drawn line still matches `shape` (points, meters) and before valid_until; a route not listed keeps the E27b rule (250 m for 45 s).
